notes.title: "New Update: Revamped Menus & Flask System"
notes.notes:
I'm excited to bring a new update that enhances both visuals and gameplay mechanics:


 Revamped menu design to better match the game’s atmosphere and look more professional


 New Flask System, allowing players to search for and use flasks in battles

Multiple flask types, each with a unique function:
Health Flask to restore HP
Stamina Flask to regain endurance
Special Attack Flask to unleash powerful moves

I hope you enjoy these new additions! Let me know your thoughts and feedback

notes.title: "New Update: Health Flasks & Improved NPC AI"
notes.notes:
In response to player requests, I’m bringing a new update with exciting features to enhance the gameplay experience:



 Added Health Flasks, which players can collect and use anytime during battles.



 Improved AI for the NPC Sholah, making interactions more dynamic and realistic.

I hope you enjoy these additions! Let me know your thoughts!

notes.title: "The Biggest Update Yet: Complete Story and Ultimate Experience"
notes.notes:
I’m thrilled to bring you the biggest update for the game to date, marking a significant step forward in the gameplay experience. Here’s what’s included:


 Complete story ending, delivering an epic conclusion to your journey.


 Brand-new levels packed with challenges and adventures.


 New enemies with unique designs and abilities to enrich battles.


 Major improvements to bosses for more thrilling and challenging encounters.


 Comprehensive performance optimizations for a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience.


This update is one of the most significant additions I’ve worked on so far. I hope you enjoy the enhanced adventure!

notes.title: "Samurai Boss Update: Enhanced Challenges Await"
notes.notes:
A highly anticipated update has been released, focusing on enhancing the Samurai Boss to deliver a more thrilling and intense experience. Here’s what’s new:


 Refined animations for the Samurai Boss’s attacks and movements for smoother and more realistic combat.


 Improved AI behavior to make the Samurai Boss more challenging.


 Increased aggressiveness to make the Samurai Boss even more ferocious in battle.


Prepare for an epic showdown with the revamped Samurai!

notes.title: "Exciting Update: Bonfire Added with Key Fixes"
notes.notes:
A new and exciting update has been released, bringing valuable additions and improvements. Here’s what’s new:


 Introduced the Bonfire feature in the game.


 Fixed several glitches to enhance game stability and provide a smoother experience.


We hope you enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: "Boss & Fixes Update: A New and Balanced Experience"
notes.notes:
A quick new update has been released, focusing on enhancing the gameplay experience with improved balance and fixes. Here’s what’s new:


 Adjusted boss balance to make damage output more fair and challenging.


 Added new animations for all bosses to enhance battle uniqueness.


 General bug and glitch fixes for a smoother experience.


 Replaced the Samurai tribe boss to make it more thrilling and challenging.


We hope you enjoy the improved gameplay experience!

notes.title: "The Major Update: Enhanced Performance, Graphics, and New Features"
notes.notes:
A major and essential update has been released for all players, bringing significant improvements and exciting additions. Here’s what’s new:


 Noticeable frame rate improvements for a better performance experience.


 Added the ability to customize controls from the main menu.


 Enhanced graphics for a more polished visual experience.


 Introduced a save feature for levels, allowing you to return to them anytime.

Enjoy the new and improved gameplay experience!

notes.title: "UI & Smoothness Update: A More Polished and Stable Experience"
notes.notes:
A new update has been released, introducing significant enhancements to gameplay. Here’s what’s new:


 Added a stamina bar for the player with a professional and unique redesign of the user interface (UI).


 General improvements to the game for smoother gameplay and more stable frame rates.


We hope you enjoy the new update and the improved gameplay experience!

notes.title: "Performance & New Enemies Update: Enhanced Gameplay and Content"
notes.notes:
A new update has been released, focusing on performance improvements and adding more content. 

Here’s what’s new:


 Comprehensive optimizations to ensure maximum frame rates for players.


 Added new enemies to the Samurai Tribe, introducing more exciting challenges.


 Fixed technical issues to improve game stability.


We hope you enjoy the enhanced experience!

notes.title: "Story & Fixes Update: Enhanced Experience and Realism"
notes.notes:
A new update has been released, focusing on improving various aspects of the game to deliver a better experience. Here’s what’s new:


 Enhanced cinematic scenes to present the story more clearly and distinctively.


 Improved enemy AI to make challenges more engaging.


 Fixed most of the issues and glitches reported by players.


 Resolved some lighting problems for a more realistic and immersive atmosphere.


We hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: "Refinement Update: Smoother Gameplay and New Challenges"🗡✨
notes.notes:
This update focuses on refining and enhancing the gameplay experience. Here's what's new:


 Perfected the timing of player attack animations for a smoother combat feel.


 Adjusted difficulty progression to offer a more balanced and gradual challenge.


 Improved game optimization in certain areas to ensure stable frame rates.


 Introduced unique new enemies to keep the battles exciting.


We hope you enjoy the improved experience!

notes.title: "Essential Update: New Enemies, Enhanced UI, and Polished Gameplay!"
notes.notes:
Hello, Warriors!
We’re excited to bring you a new update for Dark Honor! This patch includes significant improvements and exciting additions to enhance your experience. Here's what’s new:

Improved Player UI
We’ve revamped the player interface for a smoother and more intuitive experience.

New Enemies with Unique Fighting Styles
Face off against newly introduced enemies, each with their own distinctive combat techniques to challenge your skills.

Bug Fixes and Glitch Resolutions
All reported glitches and gameplay exploits have been addressed, ensuring a polished experience.

Enhanced Sound Quality
Enjoy improved audio for a more immersive gaming experience.

We hope you enjoy this update and continue to dive into the world of Dark Honor. Your feedback is always appreciated—let us know what you think!

notes.title: "Major Update: New Story Chapters, Gameplay Enhancements, and More!"
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warriors!
We’re thrilled to announce a new update for Dark Honor. This patch brings exciting improvements and fixes based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:


Story Progression
The journey continues! Dive deeper into the captivating story and uncover new twists in the tale of revenge and honor.


Healing Stations Added
Explore newly placed healing areas to recover and prepare for the challenges ahead.


Gameplay Balance
We've fine-tuned the difficulty for a fair and thrilling experience. Expect intense but rewarding battles.


Technical Fixes
Addressed and resolved most of the technical issues reported by the community. Thank you for your patience!


Save Game Functionality
Save your progress in the current stage, ensuring a seamless experience without losing hard-earned progress.
We hope you enjoy these updates and continue your journey in Dark Honor. Share your thoughts and feedback with us – your input drives the game forward!

Let me know if you'd like to tweak or add more details! 😊
